cases.sentence: Когда Адони Цедек, ___ Иерусалима, услышал об этом, он очень испугался.
cases.translation: When Adoni-Zedek, king of Jerusalem, heard of it, he was very afraid.
cases.explain: Царь is the grammatical subject of the sentence, serving as the predicate nominative after the proper name.

cases.translation: I have delivered them into your hands.
cases.explain: The accusative plural form follows the preposition в (into) indicating direction/destination.

cases.sentence: Израилетяне гнались за ними по дороге, поднимающейся в Бет-Харон, и разили их до ___.
cases.translation: The children of Israel chased them by the way of the ascent of Beth Horon, and struck them to Azekah.
cases.explain: The preposition до (until/up to) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Когда они бежали от израилетян по склону Бет-Харона в Азеку, Господь забросал их с неба огромными ___.
cases.translation: As they fled from before Israel, Yahweh hurled down great stones from the sky on them.
cases.explain: The instrumental plural follows the verb забросал (hurled/threw) indicating the instrument of action.

cases.sentence: И солнце остановилось, и стояла луна, пока народ не отомстил своим ___.
cases.translation: The sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the nation had avenged themselves of their enemies.
cases.explain: The dative plural follows the verb отомстил (avenged) with the preposition meaning 'to/against'.

cases.translation: A day when the Lord listened to a man.
cases.explain: The genitive singular form follows the verb послушался (listened to).

cases.sentence: Иисус сказал, «Откройте пещеру и выведите ко Мне тех пятерых ___».
cases.translation: Joshua said, 'Open the cave entrance, and bring those five kings out of the cave to me.'
cases.explain: The genitive plural follows the verb выведите (bring out) indicating the direct objects in accusative form.

cases.sentence: На закате Иисус приказал, и их сняли с деревьев и бросили в ___.
cases.translation: At the time of the going down of the sun, they took them down off the trees, and threw them into the cave.
cases.explain: The accusative singular follows the preposition в (into) indicating direction of movement.

reading.ru: Когда Адони Цедек, царь Иерусалима, услышал о том, что Иисус захватил Гай и полностью уничтожил его, поступив с Гаем и его царем так же, как с Иерихоном и его царем, и о том, что жители Гаваона заключили с Израилем мир и живут среди них, он очень испугался.
reading.question: Why was King Adoni-Zedek of Jerusalem very afraid?
options: Because Gibeon had made peace with Israel and Joshua had destroyed Ai and Jericho
Because his own city was under siege
Because he had lost all his soldiers in battle
Because the Israelites had taken all his treasures
reading.correct: Because Gibeon had made peace with Israel and Joshua had destroyed Ai and Jericho
reading.explain: The text explains that Adoni-Zedek heard about Joshua's destruction of Ai and Jericho and about Gibeon's peace with Israel, which made him very afraid.

reading.ru: Иисус выступил из Гилгала со всем своим войском, со всеми лучшими воинами.
reading.question: How did Joshua respond to the Gibeonites' call for help?
options: He went out from Gilgal with all his army and all the mighty men of valor
He sent a messenger to negotiate peace
He refused to help the Gibeonites
He asked God for advice before responding
reading.correct: He went out from Gilgal with all his army and all the mighty men of valor
reading.explain: The text states Иисус выступил из Гилгала со всем своим войском, со всеми лучшими воинами — Joshua went out from Gilgal with his whole army and all mighty men.

reading.ru: Иисус шел из Гилгала всю ночь и захватил своих врагов врасплох.
reading.question: How did Joshua achieve surprise against his enemies?
options: He marched from Gilgal all night and caught them by surprise
He attacked at noon when they were resting
He used deception and false messengers
He divided his army into three parts
reading.correct: He marched from Gilgal all night and caught them by surprise
reading.explain: The text says Иисус шел из Гилгала всю ночь и захватил своих врагов врасплох — Joshua marched from Gilgal all night and caught his enemies by surprise.

reading.ru: Когда они бежали от израилетян по склону Бет-Харона в Азеку, Господь забросал их с неба огромными градинами, и от каменного града погибло больше народа, чем от мечей израилетян.
reading.question: What remarkable event occurred as the enemies fled?
options: The Lord hurled large hailstones from heaven, killing more people than the Israelite swords
An earthquake opened the ground and swallowed the enemy
Darkness covered the land and confused the enemies
Fire came down from heaven and burned the camps
reading.correct: The Lord hurled large hailstones from heaven, killing more people than the Israelite swords
reading.explain: The text describes how Господь забросал их с неба огромными градинами, и от каменного града погибло больше народа, чем от мечей — the Lord threw great hailstones, and more died from the hail than from the swords.

reading.ru: Иисус возвал Господу в тот день, когда Господь отдал Амореев израилетянам, и сказал перед всем Израилем, «Стой, солнце над Гаваоном, и луна над долиною Айлон».
reading.question: What remarkable command did Joshua give in the presence of all Israel?
options: Sun, stand still over Gibeon, and moon, over the valley of Aijalon
Stop the rain and send forth the sun
Let darkness cover the land for three days
Divide the Jordan River so we may cross
reading.correct: Sun, stand still over Gibeon, and moon, over the valley of Aijalon
reading.explain: Joshua commanded «Стой, солнце над Гаваоном, и луна над долиною Айлон» — Sun, stand still over Gibeon, and moon over the valley of Aijalon.

reading.ru: После этого Иисус вернулся со всем Израилем в Гилгалский лагерь.
reading.question: Where did Joshua return after the battle?
options: To the camp at Gilgal with all Israel
To Egypt to report to Pharaoh
To the mountain to receive new laws
reading.correct: To the camp at Gilgal with all Israel
reading.explain: The text states После этого Иисус вернулся со всем Израилем в Гилгалский лагерь — After this Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.
